    (1, 3, None)

    [1, 2]

    (6, None, None)
    >>> _parse_request_range("bytes=-6")
    (-6, None, None)
    >>> _parse_request_range("bytes=")
    (None, None, None)
    >>> _parse_request_range("foo=42")
    >>> _parse_request_range("bytes=1-2,6-10")

    See [0] for the details of the range header.
